name: python-cli
description: A minimal Python command-line tool scaffold with argparse subcommands, pytest, optional Docker support, and optional Jenkins pipeline support.
recommended_use: Use for command-line utilities, dev tooling, ops scripts, and portfolio-ready Python CLI scaffolds that need an installable entry point.
smoke_test_command: set -e; test -f pyproject.toml; test -f src/python_cli_validate_smoke/cli.py; test -f tests/test_cli.py; PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "import sys; from python_cli_validate_smoke.cli import main; sys.exit(main(['run']))"; echo python-cli smoke ok
